name: @nerima-games/mc-physics
description: Pure voxel physics primitives for the nerima-games Minecraft-clone rebuild: movement, creative flight, Euler integration, AABB collision, DDA raycasts, environment effects, entity collisions, and projectile sweeps. No external physics engine.
author: takeokunn

scripts.benchmark: corepack pnpm run build && node scripts/benchmark.mjs
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src scripts test && ast-grep scan
scripts.package:verify: corepack pnpm run build && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: corepack pnpm run verify && corepack pnpm run package:verify
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --pretty false
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm run lint && corepack pnpm run test
